text: This report provides information on reserve and reserve fund balances as at May 31, 2018, indicating activity during the first five months of 2018, and projected year-end balances, based on budgeted contributions and draws. The vast majority of these funds have been committed to fund capital projects and known future liabilities, leaving minimal amounts for discretionary spending.
The Executive Committee received the report (June 26, 2018) from the Interim Chief Financial Officer for information.
